candidates.statement: Order service DB connection pool exhaustion: order traces show postgres.acquire_connection ERROR at 1050ms, order metrics show db_pool_waiters=12 and p95=900ms, and order logs show 6 db_pool_acquire_timeout errors (503), propagating to gateway call-order ERROR spans.
candidates.uncertainty: Deployment of order 3.3.9 (6 min old) may relate but deployment record alone cannot establish causation; pool sizing/config not observed.

report.explanation: Order service shows DB pool waiters (12), acquire_connection errors, and db_pool_acquire_timeout 503s, with gateway call-order errors downstream. Gateway itself is healthy (low error rate, 0 waiters). Evidence supports db-pool-exhaustion as the bounded candidate; deployment causation is not established.
missing_evidence: Postgres-side connection/session counts and max_connections to confirm pool saturation
Order service DB pool configuration (size, timeout) and whether changed in 3.3.9
Baseline order p95 and db_pool_waiters before the incident window
